label: Giftbit
description: Send reward emails, create gift links, manage rewards and check account funds

operations.name: get_account
operations.description: Check authentication and retrieve the connected username and display name.

operations.name: list_brands
operations.description: List reward brands and their required disclaimer text.

operations.name: get_brand
operations.description: Retrieve a brand's regions, allowed values and in-app availability.

operations.name: list_regions
operations.description: List regions available for reward selection.

operations.name: create_order
operations.description: Create email or shortlink rewards. Acknowledges order creation, not delivery.

operations.name: get_order
operations.description: Retrieve an order using its client-assigned ID or Giftbit UUID.

operations.name: get_links
operations.description: Retrieve shortlink or direct-link URLs; generation may still be pending.

operations.name: create_direct_link_order
operations.description: Order direct reward links with minimal branding.

operations.name: create_embedded_reward
operations.description: Create a single immediately claimed in-app reward; it cannot be cancelled.

operations.name: get_funds
operations.description: Read available, pending and reserved balances by currency.

operations.name: add_funds
operations.description: Charge the card on file to add funds. Requires a card saved in Giftbit.

operations.name: list_rewards
operations.description: List one page of rewards with the provider's filters and sorting.

operations.name: get_reward
operations.description: Retrieve an individual reward, distinct from its parent order.

operations.name: resend_reward
operations.description: Request another email delivery attempt. Embedded rewards are ineligible.

operations.name: cancel_reward
operations.description: Cancel an unclaimed reward. Embedded or already claimed rewards are ineligible.
